entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I found some info on the forum[n]about this unreasonable[n]complainer guy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Apparently he stormed into an[n]accessory shop and gave them[n]this big speech.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "I gave my girlfriend a gift from[n]this shop and she dumped me!"

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I dunno why he's blaming the[n]shop. Sounds like a personal[n]problem.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Actually, this guy is famous[n]for his complaints.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, one of the victim shops is[n]right across from the gym I go to!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I remember one time I was out[n]with the track team, and we went[n]in to check the place out...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They seemed like good people.[n]Wish I could help 'em out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I got the complainer's name.[n]It's Atsushi Yatani. Let's get[n]this guy, yeah?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji's really keeping an eye out on the[n]forum. We should do our part too!
